title: Phone Cup Holder
author: fabian.strohmei
description:
Tired of obstructed views from windshield mounts? Look no further! My 3D printed cup holder car mount keeps your phone accessible without compromising visibility. Simply slide it into your cup holder, and you’re ready to navigate hands-free. Say goodbye to windshield clutter!

iPhone 12 Pro Plus

meta.profile_notes: You can use additional materials for this project. I recommend TPU because it provides extra protection for your phone. When selecting a material, opt for one that is UV and heat resistant

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
